title: Constants built-in document type: entry shape, anchor-link citation, content comparison against source_of_truth (OPAG-425 R1, R2, R5, R6, R7, R9)
description: Binding record: opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/add-constitution-and-constants-document-types-to-lore.md. Built-in type Constants (slug constants), at most one per bundle (R2), rules in lore check (R3). R5 shape: frontmatter version (SemVer: removing an entry or changing a value is MAJOR, adding one MINOR), last_reviewed (ISO), owner; grouped by level-2 headings; each entry a level-3 heading whose text is its id matching ^[a-z0-9]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$, unique, never reused, followed by a fixed field list (the exact field syntax is lore-cli's call). Required fields value, meaning, source_of_truth (path#key or this-doc), status (active/deprecated/retired); optional kind, avoid, owner, used_by, replaced_by (required when deprecated, must name an active entry), hot. Descriptive only: facts, never rules or secrets. R6: citing is an ordinary lore link to the entry anchor; check resolves every link into the document and warns on a link to a deprecated entry. R7: where source_of_truth names a JSON, TOML or YAML file and key, the value there must EQUAL value; an unreadable source fails; print entries, comparable sources and references read beside the findings; FAIL when a Constants document exists and zero entries were read (positive control). R9: 'lore new constants' template with one example group and entry and the CODEOWNERS comment.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore check fails a bad id, a duplicate id, a missing required field, a deprecated entry without an active replaced_by, a value that differs from its JSON/TOML/YAML source_of_truth, an unreadable source, and a Constants document from which zero entries were read; it warns on a link to a deprecated entry; each proven by a test
lore check prints the counts of entries, comparable sources and references it read
lore new constants produces a document lore check passes; bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
